rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and ZIP, and the agent acted on the correct account and order. However, the agent did not obtain explicit user confirmation before performing an order-changing write. After the user selected the 1000ml stainless steel black variant, the agent said it would proceed and executed the modification in the same turn, violating the requirement to confirm the exact change and wait for explicit consent. Additionally, the agent stated that the price difference “has been refunded” without tool evidence confirming a refund transaction. There is also a potential issue of presenting specific 1000ml stainless-steel options as available without clear support from the visible product tool output, though the subsequent successful modification suggests the item exists. Due to the lack of pre-write confirmation and the unsupported refund claim, this does not meet the pass bar.
